run_shared_health_check: run shared health checks across multiple pods with Redis caching and distributed locking
acquire_health_check_lock: acquire a distributed Redis lock to coordinate health checks across pods
cache_health_check_results: cache health check results in Redis with configurable TTL for cross-pod sharing
get_cached_health_check_results: retrieve cached health check results from Redis and validate their freshness
get_health_check_status: get the current status of health check coordination including lock owner and cache age
